svg.title: Config load pipeline
svg.desc: Every production config load runs loadCliConfig, which calls loadDartclawConfig and DartclawConfig.load: locate the file, parse the YAML, reject retired keys, sweep for undescribed paths, parse the sections, parse extensions and check the container selection, resolve the four channel configs, and prime harness sections. Malformed YAML, retired keys, undescribed paths and unusable channel or harness sections throw a FormatException; bad values warn and take their default.

g.text: Hover a step for what it checks; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
A chip is a warning: the load continues with a default. A warning is blocking (a reload refuses it) or advisory. Inside a rendered document this image is static.

svg.text: Every production load runs these nine steps in order. A fatal step refuses to start; a warning chip loads a default and goes on.

g.text: environment · DARTCLAW_CONFIG, DARTCLAW_HOME and HOME locate the file; DARTCLAW_HOME supplies the default data_dir
It expands ${VAR} inside YAML strings and never overrides a YAML value; $VAR is not expanded and an undefined ${VAR} becomes empty with a warning.
dartclaw.yaml · the single config file, written back only through ConfigWriter
A dartclaw.yaml in the working directory is never discovered; if one exists an advisory says so.
CLI overrides · only some keys have a CLI override
A CLI value beats YAML, which beats the default; the environment never beats YAML. A relative CLI data_dir resolves against the working directory.
named credentials · NamedCredentialStore: one owner-only JSON file per name, written by dartclaw secrets
Merged over YAML credentials by name, the store winning; read through a provider that loadCliConfig registers.
registers the github extension parser and credential provider
loadCliConfig · apps/dartclaw_cli config_loader.dart; the entry point for every CLI load, the config API and the reload trigger
dev/fitness/test/config_load_seam_test.dart fails on a production call to DartclawConfig.load outside an allowlist.
_loadYaml: locate file · config_parser.dart picks the first of --config, DARTCLAW_CONFIG, $DARTCLAW_HOME, ~/.dartclaw
An explicit path or env var that points at a missing file warns and loads defaults.
root must be a map; a null known key takes its default
_loadYaml: parse · malformed YAML or a non-map root stops the load
Silently loading defaults would boot a container-enabled deployment unisolated, so this is fatal, not a warning.
_rejectRetiredTurnLimitKeys · each retired key throws a FormatException naming its replacement
ConfigMeta.fields, tolerated legacy keys, extension keys
_sweepConfigPaths · config_accept_set.dart holds no path literal of its own and reads the registry
One FormatException names every undescribed path, using the same wording as ConfigValidator.
CLI > YAML > default; credentials parse before search
section parsers · config_parser*.dart; credentials parse first because search, mcp_servers and embedding reference them by name
A bad value adds a blocking warning and keeps the default, so a reload of that file is refused.
extension parsers; container selection vs container.enabled
_parseExtensions + container check · validateExecutionPolicySelections runs only when container.enabled is declared
Startup resolution re-runs it once the container posture is known; execution: container while disabled is fatal.
parses the four channel types; refuses undeclared-agent rows
resolveChannelConfig ×4 · dartclaw_runtime config_load.dart; channel types live outside the kernel, so they parse here
It also refuses an unusable Slack config; warnings reach config.warnings through parseWithLoadWarnings.
runs the composed parsers (acp) over harness.<name> blocks
primeHarnessSections · config_loader.dart: the kernel keeps harness.<name> blocks as raw maps and the owning package parses them
A populated section that no composed parser claims is fatal.
immutable: 28 sections and extensions, typed warnings
DartclawConfig · config.warnings keeps every warning; reloadBlockingWarnings keeps the blocking ones
ConfigNotifier.reload refuses a config with a blocking warning, and doctor reports it as a failure.
FormatException · a fatal load is a startup gate, not a runtime one
ReloadTriggerService catches it and keeps the running config; ConfigApplyService writes nothing; doctor reports config.valid: fail (ADR-059).
